name: Bechtle AG
summary: Bechtle AG provides information technology (IT) services in Germany, France, Benelux, and Europe. It operates through IT System House & Managed Services and IT E-Commerce segments. The company offers IT strategy consulting, hardware and software solutions, IT infrastructure consulting, modern workplace, application solutions, project planning and implementation, system integration, maintenance and training to multi cloud and managed services, and IT security services and artificial intelligence.
